title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Reinstatement Fee Amount
content:
The reinstatement fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is the tier's reinstatement fee, rounded half up to the cent. The figure is the reinstatement fee in the tier's collections terms, by the tier the agreement is on at reinstatement.

The fee is assembled in a fixed order: the way the fee is built is fixed first; any share of the fee to be charged is applied next; any percentage reductions are then added into one combined percentage, applied once, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

Example (hypothetical): on a tier whose reinstatement fee is taken as 200.00 for illustration, an agreement reinstated after its past-due invoices are paid is invoiced 200.00 on the reinstatement date, due under the tier's normal payment terms.
